6. How it works

What is a SmartWallet?

A SmartWallet is a wallet that lives on the blockchain as a contract. It can borrow a flash loan from Aave, swap on Uniswap, repay the loan, and keep any profit — all in one transaction. Only the owner can withdraw, pause it, or change its settings. A trading bot can only trigger trades; it can never take funds out.

What is Tech?

Tech is a token meant to stay at $1. It is backed 1:1 by stable tokens held in its contract. Deposit stable tokens, get the same value of Tech. Burn Tech, get your stable tokens back. It only ever trades the surplus above what is needed to back all Tech — never the backing itself.

What is a flash loan?

A flash loan is borrowing money that must be paid back in the same transaction. If the trade does not cover the loan plus the fee, the whole transaction fails and nothing happens.

Honest limits

Profit is not guaranteed. Gas and price moves eat returns, and faster bots compete for the same trades. These contracts are unaudited test code on a test network. Never put in real money you cannot afford to lose.

7. Safety notes

  • This app never asks for your seed phrase or private key. If anything here ever asks for them, it is not this app — close the page.
  • All signing happens in your own wallet. Check every transaction your wallet shows you before approving it.
  • Sepolia testnet only. Nothing here has real value.
